GOVERNMENT OF TELANGANA
OFFICE OF THE DIRECTOR GOVT. MEDICAL COLLEGE
MAHABUBNAGAR DISTRICT, TELANGANA.
NOTIFICATION
Notification No.03/GMC-MBNR/2026, Dt.28.11.2026.
Walk-in-Interviews for the eligible candidates for appointment to the posts of Professors,
Associate Professors, Assistant Professors & Junior Residents on contract basis on a purely
temporary basis for a period up to 31.03.2027 or till actual need ceases (or) till the regular posts are
filled up whichever is earlier, in the required specialties to work in the Govt. Medical Colleges /
Government General Hospitals under control of the Director of Medical Education, Telangana.

4. Selection Criteria – Candidates will be selected based on the following Criteria: -
1. The Selection of candidates will be as per the TEQ (Teachers Eligibility Qualification)
Regulations - 2025 of National Medical Council (NMC) including the prevailing amendments
and other selection criteria mention below.
a) Marks obtained in MD/MS/DNB PG Degree for Assistant Professor posts. Marks obtained in
MBBS for CAS and Junior Resident posts (If marks are not awarded in the qualifying exam
50% of marks will be considered)
b) For Professor and Associate Professor the duration of their teaching experience in that cadre
will be considered for selection criteria.
c) DNB candidates will be selected as per the latest TEQ (Teachers Eligibility Qualification)
Regulations - 2025 of National Medical Council (NMC).
d) Selection of candidates will be nationwide.
e) First preference is given to local candidates.
f) The age of the applicant should be below 69 years for Professor, Associate Professor
Assistant Professor and below 45 years for Junior Residents.
g) The selected candidate will have to submit the relieving order from their previous institute,
failing which their selection will stand cancelled.
h) The candidates who have joined and working in any other Medical Colleges of Telangana on
contract basis in same cadre are not eligible to apply.
i) During the period of contract, the faulty will be paid a consolidated monthly remuneration
depending upon the post as per G.O. Rt. No. 1276 Finance (HRM-VII) Department, Dated:
16.07.2026. The remuneration shall be all inclusive and subject to deduction of tax at source
and/ or any other statutory deductions to the extent required under the laws.
Consolidated pay of the Faculty:
Sl. No. Name of the Post Consolidated Remuneration
1 Professor Rs.1,90,000/-
2 Associate Professor Rs.1,50,000/-
3 Assistant Professor Rs.1,25,000/-
4. Junior Resident Rs.46,000/-
5. Terms and Conditions: -
a) The selected faculty will be eligible for fifteen (15) days leave in a calendar year on
cumulative basis.
b) The appointment as contract employee is purely temporary basis upto 31.03.2027 or till the
vacancies is filled by promotion/ regular appointment, whichever is earlier. This contract
placement does not confer any right for future Government appointment.
c) If the selected candidate is not joining then the next eligible merit candidate will be selected.
d) The candidates should come along with the application form, original certificates and two
sets of self-attested Xerox copies at the time of walk-in interview.
e) Selection candidates should submit bond on Rs. 100 stamp paper duly notarized to the
Director, Govt. Medical College, Mahabubnagar. If any candidates break the bond, he/she
has to pay 3 months’ salary.
f) If any selected candidate willing to terminate the contract, He/She has to give 01 months
prior notice.
g) The age of the applicant should be below 69 years for Professor, Associate Professor and
Assistant Professor and below 45 years for JRs on the day of Notification
h) The contract is liable to be terminated at any time, without assigning any reason whatsoever.
i) The engaged faculty will be at the disposal of the institute on whole time basis and his/her
service may be utilized in any manner required by the Competent Authority of the Institute
without any claims for any additional remuneration.
j) The decision of the selection committee is final and binding.
Note: - The Original Certificates MBBS, MD. / MS / DNB Degree along with MBBS Registration
and M.S/ M.D./ DNB Degree / Specialty Degree Registration, Senior Residency Certificate,
BCBR Certificate, MET Certificate, Experience Certificate, Relieving Order of the Previous
Institute and Publication have to be submitted at the time joining, and will be under the
custody of Director, GMC, Mahabubnagar.
6. Instructions to the candidates for Walk in Interviews;
a) The Application form will be available at College website www.gmcmbnr-ts.org A filled in
applications should be submitted along with Xerox copies of documents mentioned below on
the day of interview and individual should carry all original certificates also.
b) Aadhar Card and PAN card
c) Proof of Date of Birth ( SSC /Birth certificate)
d) Study/ Bonafide certificates 1st to 7th.
e) MBBS and MD/MS/DNB Degree
f) Marks memos of MBBS & MD / MS/ DNB/M.Sc.
g) MBBS and PG Registrations from the Telangana State Medical Council.
***Outside state candidates should get their qualification registered from Telangana State
Medical Council within one week of selection, for their appointment to be confirmed.***
h) Experience Certificates.
i) Senior Residency Completion Certificate.
